# IDAES 2.13 oracle data

The NRTL oracle banks are regenerated by `just nrtl-reference`. IDAES 2.13 supplies its
own equations; Pyomo isolates their dependent variables in construction order. The
binary off-diagonal tau=1 and alpha=0.3 retain IDAES defaults. Diagonal tau is explicitly
zero to preserve the pure-component standard state; this differs from the constructor's
all-entry tau initialization. Observations cover benzene fractions 0.2, 0.5 and 0.8.
The native fixture compares both activity coefficients, the binary excess closed form
and every weighted Hessian column of the extensive potential (Gibbs-Duhem).
